title: Will You Marry Me? 💍
message: From the moment we met, I knew you were special. Over these beautiful years together, you've shown me what true love really means. You're my best friend, my confidant, my everything. I can't imagine spending a single day without you by my side. Today, I want to ask you the most important question of my life. Will you make me the happiest person alive and be my forever? I promise to love you, cherish you, and make you smile every single day for the rest of our lives.

timeline.title: Our Beginning
timeline.description: We met through mutual friends at that New Year celebration. Little did I know, I was meeting my soulmate.

timeline.title: First Date Magic
timeline.description: Valentine's Day, 2020. Our first official date at that Italian restaurant. We laughed, talked, and connected like never before.

timeline.title: The COVID Journey
timeline.description: Lockdown brought us closer. Video calls every night, virtual dates, and falling deeper in love despite the distance.

timeline.title: Moving In Together
timeline.description: We found our perfect little apartment and started building our home together. Every day became an adventure.

timeline.title: Meeting Each Other's Families
timeline.description: Thanksgiving 2022. Both our families came together, and it felt like one big happy family. This was when I knew for sure.

timeline.title: Today - Our Forever Starts
timeline.description: This is the day I ask you to be mine forever. The beginning of our greatest adventure yet. Will you marry me?
